text:
maria.h: Heads up — planning to roll out a "sticky routing" policy for audit-export requests so compliance reviews always hit Dedicated GPU pools (isolated infra) instead of general-hosted lanes. We need two things: a console badge that shows "Export routed to Dedicated" and a quota/backpressure strategy for export-heavy tenants. Thoughts?

jon: +1 on a badge, otherwise legal will keep asking. how do we flag which exports are "sensitive" vs normal bulk?

priya: We should gate by export type + PII flag in the event. If export payload contains pii=true, route to dedicated. Non-PII can still go to hosted.

lewis: Are we also considering stickiness by tenant or by request? i.e., once a tenant is pinned to Dedicated for x minutes, all subsequent exports go there to avoid cross-attach surprises.

maria.h: Good q. Proposal: tenant-level sticky TTL (default 1h) + per-request override if compliance_review=true. TTL should be configurable per-tenant via console.

priya: For quota/backpressure: exports are heavy. We should pre-allocate an export token bucket on Dedicated and fall back with a presigned-polling flow when exhausted. Also expose metric: export_queue_depth and export_dedicated_fill.

jon: Agree. UX note: console badge should link to export routing history (last 10 exports and reason). Maybe a "why routed" tooltip showing rule match.

lewis: Implementation sketch for rules config (pseudo):
```
export_routing:
  rules:
    - match: { pii: true }
      route: dedicated
      ttl: 3600
    - match: { compliance_review: true }
      route: dedicated
      ttl: 0 # immediate
    - match: {}
      route: hosted
```

maria.h: Nice. Also need telemetry: a per-export tag `routing_decision` with values [dedicated, hosted, fallback_presigned]. And `routing_reason` free text enum for UI. These should be in our event schema so console can show counts.

eng-platform-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployed export-routing-service v2 to dev cluster at 2026-03-21T10:05:12Z :rocket:

priya: Console badge copy idea: "Routed to Dedicated (compliance)" with a small shield icon and link to audit trail. Also a tooltip: "Exports routed to Dedicated when rule X matched".

jon: Edge case: tenant A has TTL pinned to Dedicated but their reserved capacity is exhausted. We should fallback to fallback_presigned and notify the tenant via console with an action item (request burst increase).

lewis: For export telemetry retention, ops asked for 90 days for audit. We should sample full export payloads for 30 days, keep routing metadata and hashes for 90 days. Redaction rules still apply.

ops: Ops POV: needs alerts when export_queue_depth > 80% for >5min across dedicated pool. Also runtime logs should include shard and model variant used for verification.

maria.h: OK action items: 1) Priya to add routing_decision + routing_reason to export event schema and wire to telemetry (ETA 2d). 2) Lewis to prototype TTL config UI + tooltip (ETA 1w). 3) Jon to spec quota fallback UX & alerting (ETA 3d). 4) Ops to add alert thresholds (we'll pair on runbooks). I'll open PR for rule config proto.

jon: thx, will follow up in PR. :thumbsup:

priya: I'll add example events and unit tests for redaction + routing tag.

maria.h: Thanks everyone. If no objections I'll start the rollout plan Monday — canary -> canary+tenants -> global.

lewis: No objections. small ask: mark the console change as "opt-in" per-tenant for first month.

maria.h: Done, will include opt-in toggle in console mockups.
